# NMark Designs

> Boutique web development and design studio founded by Nikola Marković. Specialized in high-performance Next.js web applications, custom business websites, e-commerce, and technical SEO for clients in Serbia, Europe, and the United States.

## Core Identity & Positioning

- **Studio Name**: NMark Designs
- **Founder & Lead Developer**: Nikola Marković
- **Website**: https://nmarkdesigns.com
- **Languages**: Serbian (Primary, `/sr/`), English (`/en/`)
- **Key Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, WordPress (Headless / Monolith), Cloudflare, Node.js
- **Value Proposition**: Senior-level boutique execution, zero agency overhead, 100/100 Core Web Vitals performance, conversion-focused design, and transparent pricing.

---

## Services & Offerings

### 1. Izrada Web Sajtova / Website Development
- **URLs**:
  - Serbian: https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/usluge/izrada-web-sajtova/
  - English: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/services/website-development/
- **Description**: High-performance landing pages, corporate, and business websites built for maximum speed, SEO indexing, and lead generation.
- **Starting Price**: From €300 / $350 (Landing page) to €900+ / $1,000+ (Advanced corporate).
- **Featured Case Study**: OŠ Dule Karaklajić (https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/portfolio/os-dule-karaklajic/)

### 2. Web Prodavnice (E-commerce) / E-Commerce Development
- **URLs**:
  - Serbian: https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/usluge/web-prodavnice/
  - English: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/services/ecommerce-development/
- **Description**: Fast, conversion-optimized WooCommerce and custom online stores with seamless payment gateways, inventory management, and zero layout shift.
- **Starting Price**: From €1,200 / $1,350.
- **Featured Case Studies**: Tripoli Sweets (https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/portfolio/tripolisweets/), Anabela Bebi Oprema (https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/portfolio/anabelabebioprema/)

### 3. Custom Web Aplikacije / Custom Web Applications
- **URLs**:
  - Serbian: https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/usluge/custom-web-aplikacije/
  - English: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/services/custom-web-applications/
- **Description**: Bespoke Next.js and React full-stack applications, interactive portals, real-time calculators, and third-party API integrations.
- **Pricing**: Project-based scope / quote.

### 4. Web Dizajn i Redizajn / Web Design & Redesign

### 5. SEO i Optimizacija Brzine / SEO & Speed Optimization

  - English: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/services/seo-and-speed-optimization/

  - English: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/services/website-maintenance/

## Verified International & Domestic Case Studies

1. **Cool Fridge Guys (United States)**:
   - Commercial refrigeration & HVAC specialist in Texas, USA.
   - Result: Modern high-performance web presence targeting commercial contractors in the US market.
   - URL: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/portfolio/coolfridgeguys/

2. **Tripoli Sweets (International / E-commerce)**:
   - Authentic Lebanese handmade baklava and sweets e-commerce store.
   - Result: Multi-category e-commerce catalog, responsive mobile ordering, seamless checkout.
   - URL: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/portfolio/tripolisweets/

3. **OŠ Dule Karaklajić (Public Educational Institution)**:
   - Official institutional portal serving students, teachers, and parents.
   - Result: Modern redesign replacing legacy CMS, high accessibility, rapid mobile loading.
   - URL: https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/portfolio/os-dule-karaklajic/

4. **Ilić Enterijer (Interior Design & Furniture)**:
   - Bespoke furniture, acoustic slat panels, and custom interior solutions.
   - Result: Core Web Vitals 95+, semantic structured data, prominent local search visibility.
   - URL: https://nmarkdesigns.com/sr/portfolio/ilic-enterijer/

5. **Buy Pallet Jacks (Industrial Equipment / US Market)**:
   - Industrial material handling and pallet jack equipment catalog.
   - URL: https://nmarkdesigns.com/en/portfolio/buy-pallet-jacks/
